summary: Moved all date/time parsing into deskstats/timeparse.py (other modules keep their public functions as thin wrappers, including original exception types so the CLI is unchanged) and added tests/test_timeparse.py; existing tests pass and a differential check against the original matched. Note: the guide's table says chats use TRUNCATE, but the current code rounds to nearest even, so I kept NEAREST_EVEN to leave reports unchanged; the guide also leaves a time range/overflow crash (inf, 1e30 epochs) as it was.
